value: If a normal support witness has a redundant support coordinate c, deleting c and renormalizing gives a smaller witness or refutes support-minimality under the selected support measure.

Under the redundancy precondition, support_size strictly decreases and counterexample status transfers to a smaller witness; failure to satisfy the precondition is named non-application, not proof success.
normal support witness W with finite support set S and coordinate c in S
support_size k to k-1; lexicographic measure strictly decreases
no redundant coordinate -> next operation or named higher-support/non-family-chain escape after all operations fail
normal-form preservation under deletion;payload-refinement transfer;canonical reindexing;family-chain field irrelevance;other operation sublemmas
Does not prove every support>8 witness has a redundant coordinate and does not prove all support-reduction operations.
